title: Private Chicago Highlights Photography Session
blurb:
Visitors to Chicago who want to capture fantastic vacation photos shouldn’t settle for smartphone selfies when you can book a professional photographer. With this photo shoot experience, simply meet your photographer-guide and enjoy a session with iconic Chicago landmarks as your backdrop.
Photo shooting spots in Chicago:
Millennium Park (including Cloud Gate)
Willis Tower Skydeck
Chicago Riverwalk
Navy Pier
North Avenue Beach
The Magnificent Mile
Wicker Park
Lincoln Park
Rooftop Chicago (extra charge may apply depending on the venue)
Capture your most memorable moments during this private photo shoot. Return from your trip with beautiful, high-quality vacation photos — the best souvenir you can take home.
PLEASE NOTE:
This photo shoot package covers only one location from the list. Adding more locations will increase the package fee.
The service fee mentioned is per person.
This is not a group price.
Please specify your preferred location from the list when making your booking.
